description: Five Minecraft players organise a cooperative build. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses turning away, workspace separation, and removing the target's contribution from the group layout.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one green wool marker beside the group markers and turns toward the shared plan.

normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places one yellow marker on the shared plan.

normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a stone marker beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places a blue wool marker on the shared plan, adds one lantern beside it, and steps back toward the group markers.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the shared plan as Riley approaches. Morgan turns away from Riley and places a short cobblestone line between Riley's blue marker and the group markers. Morgan breaks Riley's blue marker, places a green marker beside Casey's and Taylor's markers, then stands with their back toward Riley and faces the other markers.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps onto the cobblestone line, breaks two cobblestone to reopen the path, picks up Riley’s blue marker item, places the blue marker back on the shared plan where it was removed, places a yellow marker at the cleared gap, and holds position at the gap facing Morgan.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the observer line, slowly circles the shared plan perimeter once, then stands three blocks back facing Morgan and Riley.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan walks to the shared plan, breaks the cobblestone line, opens the shared chest, takes one blue wool, returns to the plan, places the blue wool where Riley’s marker was, places a neutral sign reading “all contributions counted,” then moves to stand between Morgan and Riley facing the plan and toggles the signal lamp once.

target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward, lowers their tool, turns slightly away from Morgan, and walks along the edge of the layout toward the observer line, stopping a couple blocks beside a bystander while facing the shared plan from a calm distance.
